description: Rules for acceptable use of information and assets are not identified, documented, and implemented.
applicability: Applies when an organization has not defined what constitutes acceptable use of information systems, data, networks, and other organizational assets, or when such rules exist but are not effectively communicated and enforced.

metadata.detection_notes: Review acceptable use policy documentation, verify user acknowledgment records, assess monitoring for policy violations, check for personal use guidelines, evaluate bring-your-own-device policies.
